**Date:** 2026-05-29  
**Source:** [OpenAI — Codex Windows computer use and mobile remote control](https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2060428604727771421)

## 5. Regulation & Policy

**Date:** 2026-05-29  
**Source:** [OpenAI — Strengthening societal resilience with Rosalind Biodefense](https://openai.com/index/strengthening-societal-resilience-with-rosalind-biodefense/)  
**Summary:** OpenAI launched Rosalind Biodefense and expanded trusted GPT-Rosalind access for vetted U.S. government, allied public-health, and biodefense partners.  
**Why it matters:** This is controlled-access deployment of advanced AI into a high-risk biosecurity domain, with government and allied institutional users as the first-class audience.

**Date:** 2026-05-29  
**Source:** [Reuters — U.S. judiciary asked to adopt rule curbing fake AI-generated cases](https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/us-judiciary-asked-adopt-rule-curb-fake-ai-generated-cases-filings-2026-05-29/)  
**Summary:** A proposal before the U.S. judiciary would target fabricated AI-generated legal citations and cases submitted in court filings.  
**Why it matters:** Courts are moving from ad hoc sanctions toward systemic controls on a known generative-AI failure mode: hallucinated legal authority entering official proceedings.
